title.orig: An Act Declaring July 7 of Every Year a Special Working Public Holiday in the City of Carcar, Province of Cebu to be Known as the "City of Carcar Charter Day"
title.vi: Ngày Hiến chương Thành phố Carcar
title.th: วันก่อตั้งตามกฎบัตรของเมือง Carcar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2013/ra_10358_2013.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: July 7 of every year is hereby declared to be a special working public holiday in the City of Carcar, Province of Cebu to commemorate its founding day and to be known as the "City of Carcar Charter Day".
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
